units.source_text: 源氏公子不能探得这女子的来历，因此自己也不把姓名告诉她。

en.t: Prince Genji could not discover the woman's background, and so he did not tell her his own name either.

units.source_text: 他穿上一身粗陋服装，以免受人注目；

en.t: He put on a set of plain, shabby clothes so that he would not attract attention;

units.source_text: 也不像平常那样乘车骑马，只是徒步往来。

en.t: nor did he ride in a carriage or on horseback as usual, but simply came and went on foot.

units.source_text: 惟光心中想：“主子对这个人的爱，不是平常的了。”

en.t: Koremitsu thought to himself, "My lord's love for this person is no ordinary matter."

units.source_text: 就将他自己的马让给公子乘用，自己徒步随从。

en.t: So he gave his own horse to the prince to ride and followed along on foot himself.

units.source_text: 一面心中懊恼，他想：“我也是个情郎，

en.t: At the same time he felt vexed and thought, "I am a lover too,

units.source_text: 这么寒酸地步行，教情妇看见了丢脸！”

en.t: and if my beloved saw me walking in such a shabby way, it would be humiliating!"

units.source_text: 源氏公子生怕被人认出，身边只带两个人，

en.t: Prince Genji was terribly afraid of being recognized, so he brought only two people with him,

units.source_text: 一个就是那天替他摘夕颜花的随从，

en.t: one was the attendant who had picked the evening face flower for him that day,

units.source_text: 另一个是别人完全不认识的童子。

en.t: and the other was a boy whom no one else knew at all.

units.source_text: 还怕女家有线索可寻，连大弍乳母家也不敢去访了。

en.t: He was also afraid that the woman's household might provide some clue, so he no longer dared even to visit the home of his nurse, the wife of the Assistant Governor.
